content:
maria_sales: Heads up — prospect (BigBank Corp) says their PoC must run in a sealed data center with zero outbound internet. They also require signed bundles, SBOM, and an upgrade cadence limited to quarterly windows. Can we run a weekday evening POC with a one-off installer delivered via USB?

anna_se: Confirming: no outbound NAT at all? or just limited egress via a proxy?

maria_sales: Zero outbound. They explicitly said "no egress, no DNS, no external package pulls." They can do sneakernet (USB or airgapped media) or a controlled pull from an internal artifact repo.

devon_sre: OK. We can produce a self-contained installer image. Questions: do they require an orchestrator (k8s) or single-node VM? Also need HSM/KMS integration for keys?

maria_sales: They'll prefer k8s (RHEL CoreOS) but will accept a VM proof for POC. HSM for key wrap is desired — they use a YubiHSM that we need to support via PKCS#11.

kevin_security: @maria_sales please capture threat model: physical media transfer, signed and time-stamped artifacts, reproducible SBOM, and offline cert rotation. They want us to prove signature verification offline.

anna_se: For packaging options we can do: 1) single signed tarball with everything, 2) delta patch bundles for smaller transfers, 3) OCI image bundle if they have an internal registry. Signed manifests + detached signatures for each variant.

devon_sre: Recommend single signed tarball for the initial POC (simpler) and include checksums + an offline signature verification step: 
```
# on host
sha256sum redwood-offline-2026-03-21.tar.gz > sha256.txt
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood.tar.sig sha256.txt
```
This avoids needing a package manager.

maria_sales: Great — what about upgrades? Prospect expects quarterly cadence. They want ability to apply only security patches between quarters if critical.

kevin_security: We can commit to quarterly feature releases for on-prem customers and a separate critical patch track. Need to add SLA language to the SOW for out-of-band security patches. Also must provide signed delta patches and a rollback story.

devon_sre: Rollback plan: keep previous image in /opt/redwood/releases/{timestamp} and provide `redwoodctl rollback --to <timestamp>`. For DB migrations we'll do backward-compatible-first migrations for POC to avoid downtime.

anna_se: Networking: They require firewall rules list we will open. Typical ports: 8443 (API), 9000 (metrics, optional), 22 (jumpbox only). But with zero egress we need to ensure no telemetry or pings. We'll include a config flag `telemetry.enabled=false`.

maria_sales: They also asked about licensing: offline license activation with an enterprise key file rather than contacting an activation endpoint. Feasible?

kevin_security: Yes. Provide a signed license blob (JWT-like) that they install. We'll add signature verification using the same PKI. Document the install steps and key rotation.

devon_sre: Ops checklist for POC delivery (draft):
- Pre-signed tarball + detached signature
- SBOM.txt and provenance metadata
- Offline install script and `redwoodctl` binary
- USB transfer checklist and integrity verification snippet
- Rollback and logs export commands
- HSM PKCS#11 config sample

maria_sales: Great. Can we deliver that in a 2-week window? Customer wants to start next Tue.

anna_se: Two weeks is tight but doable for a minimal POC image and docs. Need sign-off on HSM support — if they require integration testing with their YubiHSM we'll need remote test vectors or hardware on-site.

kevin_security: Also need legal to approve the one-off license and data handling in the SOW. I'll loop in legal after this thread.

ops_bot: Deploy-bot: created ticket ENG-ONPREM-4821 for "BigBank sealed-site PoC — packaging & offline install" assigned to devon_sre, anna_se. ETA 2 weeks.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll confirm kickoff time with customer and ship the acceptance criteria (install + basic generate/serve test + security checklist). Thanks all :thumbsup:
